options.content: Pilots: Live now · Traffic · New pilots · Origins · Records · Routes · Aircraft · Military | ATC: Overview · Retention · Hours · Positions · Ranks | Events: Live events · Monday events | Management: **Monthly** · Health All times are UTC. Figures cover VATPAC airspace.

Months are UTC calendar months. 'Pilots with Y' means the fourth character from the end of the pilot's name is 'Y' (a home airport code starting with Y). Pilots are those who filed a flight plan. Pilot hours are time online per flight, from the first to the last stored position inside the Australian airspace polygon. There is no backfill, so the charts start at go-live.

panels.title: Australian-based pilots and ATC online each month
panels.description: Australian-based pilots, all pilots and controllers online each month (UTC).

targets.rawSql:
WITH flight_summaries AS (
  -- v3 stand-in for the v1 table: one row per flight
  SELECT cid, name, logon_time,
         end_time AS completion_time,
         airborne_minutes AS total_enroute_time_minutes,
         duration_minutes AS time_online_minutes
  FROM flight
),
pilot_stats AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') as month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cid) FILTER (WHERE LENGTH(name) >= 4 AND SUBSTRING(name FROM LENGTH(name) - 3 FOR 1) = 'Y') as unique_pilots_with_Y,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cid) as total_unique_pilots
    FROM flight_summaries
    WHERE logon_time IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
),
atc_stats AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', session_start_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') as month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cid) as total_unique_atc
    FROM controller_summaries
    WHERE session_start_time IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', session_start_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(p.month, a.month) as month,
    COALESCE(p.unique_pilots_with_Y, 0) as unique_pilots_with_Y,
    COALESCE(p.total_unique_pilots, 0) as total_unique_pilots,
    COALESCE(a.total_unique_atc, 0) as total_unique_atc
FROM pilot_stats p
FULL OUTER JOIN atc_stats a ON p.month = a.month
ORDER BY month

panels.title: Pilot hours per month (names with Y)
panels.description: Hours online per month (UTC) by Australian-based pilots, from 1 September of the current year.

targets.rawSql:
WITH flight_summaries AS (
  -- v3 stand-in for the v1 table: one row per flight
  SELECT cid, name, logon_time,
         end_time AS completion_time,
         airborne_minutes AS total_enroute_time_minutes,
         duration_minutes AS time_online_minutes
  FROM flight
)
SELECT
  to_char(date_trunc('month', completion_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
  ROUND(SUM(time_online_minutes) / 60.0, 2) AS total_hours
FROM flight_summaries
WHERE
  name IS NOT NULL
  AND length(name) >= 4
  AND SUBSTRING(name, LENGTH(name) - 3, 1) = 'Y'
  AND completion_time >= (date_trunc('year', now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') + interval '8 months') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'  -- 1 September (UTC) of the current year
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
